key_insight: HECKTOR 2025 benchmarks multimodal PET/CT AI for three head and neck cancer tasks: tumor segmentation, recurrence-free survival prediction, and HPV status classification.
clinical_relevance: The benchmark supports development of automated tools that could improve radiotherapy planning and risk stratification in head and neck cancer workflows.
method: Multi-institutional PET/CT and electronic health record dataset from 10 centers
Three tasks: GTVp/GTVn segmentation, recurrence-free survival prediction, HPV classification
Held-out test set with 15 final team submissions for comparison
evidence_signal: The abstract reports over 1,100 patients, 35 registered teams, and top scores of Dice 0.75 for segmentation, c-index 0.66 for survival, and balanced accuracy 0.56 for HPV classification.
watch_item: Performance remains modest for prognosis and HPV prediction, so real-world clinical use would need careful validation and workflow integration.
paper_title: HEad and neCK TumOR (HECKTOR) 2025: Benchmark of Segmentation, Diagnosis, and Prognosis in Multimodal PET/CT
